svg.text: Annotations: what each element maps to
1 Draft banner: <Surface className="draft-banner">, the yf-surface card skin (--card, --line, --radius, --shadow-card). Copy, role="status", Resume and Discard stay.
2 Kicker: PageHeader kicker="Start something". It renders p.ex-kicker.yf-header-kicker (12px, 700, uppercase, --ink-teal). It replaces p.eyebrow.
3 Title: PageHeader headline={{ lead: "Plan a new", accent: "trip" }}. h1.yf-header-title is Playfair Display 600, 44px. One serif on the page (R14).
4 Lede: PageHeader lede. p.yf-header-lede, 17px (16px on a phone), --text-2. The words do not change.
5 Header rule: .yf-header, 1px --line, padding-bottom 20px (--space-8), margin-bottom 24px (--space-10).
6 Section title: h2 in Plus Jakarta Sans 800, 18px, line height 1.3 (R20). It was 16px Sora (.tpl-warm-head h2).
7 Cover: <TripArt region=... /> inside .tpl-cov, now position: relative and 92px high. It replaces the emoji span and the inline coverGradient.
8 Days chip: .tpl-cov .days is unchanged. It sits above the art (z-index) with the --card pill.
9 Card text: .tpl-bd b is 18px/1.3 800 (R20). Route and price rise from 11px to 12px. The price string comes from fmtBand, unchanged.
10 Picked state: .tpl-card.on keeps the --teal border, the --teal-soft ring and the .tpl-pick tick. aria-pressed does not change.
11 Start blank: .tpl-blank is unchanged. It still closes the strip and matches the row height.
12 Phone strip: at 640px and below, .tpl-strip becomes one scroll-snap row of 236px cards. The next card peeks in. See question 1.
13 Grey blocks: Trip Ticket rail, form blocks, helper chips and the fixed dock (styles.css:5954) are not in scope.
14 Art source: TripArt regions kerala, rajasthan and goa, and generic for Himalayan Loop, as regionFor() resolves them now.
Art comes from the manifest and the regionArt.ts fallback chain (docs/ART-PIPELINE.md). Real images swap in later with no layout change.
Question 1: May the phone strip become a scroll-snap row? Or must the four cards stay stacked as they are now?
Question 2: May the h1 split as "Plan a new" plus accent "trip"? The accessible name stays "Plan a new trip".
Differences against the current page (written before any edit)
1. Banner: tinted --teal-soft box with a teal border (.draft-banner, 12px radius) -> white Surface card (18px radius, card shadow).
2. Kicker: plain .eyebrow, grey -> .ex-kicker in --ink-teal with wide tracking, as on Explore and Profile.
3. Title: h1 is Sora 28px (global h1 rule, sans) -> Playfair Display 600, 44px, italic teal accent on "trip" (R14).
4. Lede: .muted.small, 13.5px -> .yf-header-lede, 17px desktop and 16px phone, --text-2.
5. Header frame: no rule under the header -> 1px --line rule and 24px gap, the same as every converted page.
6. Section title: 16px Sora -> 18px Plus Jakarta Sans 800, line height 1.3 (R20).
7. Cover: 64px gradient plus an emoji -> 92px TripArt papercut art by region. The emoji field leaves the card.
8. Card title: 12.5px bold -> 18px 800. Route and price: 11px -> 12px. The card is 28px taller.
9. Himalayan Loop: its emoji is a mountain -> generic art, the fallback regionFor() returns today. No new art, no region field.
10. Phone strip: four cards stacked, about 660px tall -> one scroll-snap row, about 188px tall. The form starts higher.
11. Unchanged: Trip Ticket rail, readiness logic, fixed dock, every form field, Start blank, helper chips, the pick tick, all copy.
Grey dashed blocks are unchanged context. Numbered circles match the annotation list.
